(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let ((bg (mode g -1)))
             (for-each-object g
                              (objects g bg)
                              (lambda (acc obj)
                                (if (> (obj-size obj) 1)
                                    (paint-cells acc (obj-cells obj) 8)
                                    acc)))))))
